sql:
SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_size = 50
EXCEPT
SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_availqty < 100

extra.AI Reason: The EXCEPT operator is implemented using a Hashed SetOp node to remove duplicates and perform the set difference.
Aggregate the results of the first query to prepare for the set operation.
Sequential scan is chosen for the part table as there is no index on p_size.
Aggregate the results of the second query to prepare for the set operation.
Sequential scan is chosen for the partsupp table as there is no index on ps_availqty.
